stem: A client develops sudden severe unilateral pelvic pain with nausea and vomiting. Which diagnosis requires urgent evaluation because it can compromise ovarian blood flow?
rationale: Ovarian torsion is a gynecologic surgical emergency caused by twisting of the adnexa that can impair vascular flow. Sudden unilateral pelvic or lower-abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting is a characteristic presentation.
educational_objective: Recognize the acute symptom pattern of ovarian torsion and its need for urgent evaluation.
source_organization: National Library of Medicine / NCBI Bookshelf (StatPearls)
source_locator: Clinical presentation and emergency nature: sudden unilateral pelvic/abdominal pain, often nausea/vomiting; torsion compromises blood supply
source_claim_supported: Ovarian torsion commonly presents with sudden unilateral pelvic pain and nausea/vomiting and is a surgical emergency.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
correction_summary: Replaced an adolescent-specific ACOG source with a general current NCBI source appropriate to the generic adult scenario.
